description: Purpose-built minimalist KVM VMM from AWS for secure, multi-tenant containers and serverless workloads; originator of the 'microVM' term.
name: Firecracker

description: Rust VMM for modern cloud workloads built on rust-vmm crates; runs on KVM and Microsoft Hypervisor (MSHV).
name: Cloud Hypervisor

description: OCI/CRI-compatible secure container runtime that runs each pod inside a lightweight VM for hardware-enforced isolation.
features: Rust runtime-rs default in 4.0.0 (Go runtime deprecated)
QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor, Dragonball, Firecracker hypervisors
virtio-fs, EROFS snapshotter, dm-verity rootfs, virtio-mem
name: Kata Containers

description: Lightweight built-in VMM for Kata's Rust runtime (Alibaba/Ant Group contribution); default VMM in Kata 4.0.0.
features: integrated into runtime-rs as default VMM
name: Dragonball

description: CNCF Sandbox stack extending Kata Containers to run workloads inside hardware-TEE-backed confidential VMs with remote attestation.
features: AMD SEV-SNP, Intel TDX, IBM Secure Execution
attestation via Trustee; signed and sealed secrets
name: Confidential Containers

description: Userspace application kernel (Go) implementing a Linux-like interface to sandbox containers; explicitly NOT a hardware VM.
features: runsc OCI runtime; Docker/Kubernetes + containerd shim
syscall interposition limits host-kernel attack surface
name: gVisor (runsc)

description: Secure, lightweight Rust VMM built for ChromeOS (Crostini Linux, ARCVM Android), now used across Android, Windows, and Cuttlefish.
features: KVM, Gunyah, GenieZone, Halla; WHPX/HAXM on Windows
broad virtio device model incl. 3D GPU, TPM, video decode
name: crosvm

description: Firecracker-inspired minimalist machine type inside QEMU for microVM-style direct-kernel-boot workloads.
features: x86-specific direct kernel boot without BIOS
optional legacy timers/serial only when requested
no device hotplug; no cross-version live migration
name: QEMU microvm machine type

description: Minimal, fast KVM-based VMM intended as a simple native virtualization tool for Linux.
features: no live migration or UEFI support
name: kvmtool (lkvm)

description: Specialized Rust hypervisor for running HermitOS unikernels as lightweight VMs.
features: purpose-built for the Hermit unikernel (Rust library OS)
networking and filesystem hypercalls instead of device emulation
name: uhyve

description: Sandboxed unikernel execution environment that runs MirageOS-style unikernels via small 'tender' backends.
features: startup comparable to process loading (no guest OS boot)
used by MirageOS and NanoVMs-style deployments
name: Solo5

description: Lightweight dynamic KVM library exposing a C API so programs can easily run processes in partially isolated, virtualized environments.
features: embeddable VMM library with C API (no separate VMM process)
KVM on Linux; Hypervisor.framework on Apple Silicon
minimal device model: virtio networking, filesystems, vsock
main is unstable 2.0 dev line; stable-* branches for production
name: libkrun

description: CLI that turns OCI container images into libkrun-based microVMs with no disk-image maintenance.
features: runs OCI images directly as microVMs
Linux/KVM on x86_64 and aarch64; macOS/HVF on ARM64
host volume mapping and guest port exposure
name: krunvm

description: libkrun-backed containerd runtime / Kubernetes node agent (krunkitd) for running pods inside microVMs.
features: turns Kubernetes/containerd workloads into libkrun microVMs
reportedly adopted by Podman Machine on macOS (unverified official source)
macOS + Linux support via libkrun backends
name: krunkit

description: Rust KVM VMM from the openEuler ecosystem with both a 'microvm' mode and a standard full-featured mode.
features: lightweight microvm and standard machine models
x86_64 and aarch64; virtio-mmio in microvm mode
QMP, libvirt, and OCI-compatible management interfaces
name: StratoVirt

description: Experimental Google VMM written in Rust, exploring a modern KVM/HVF-based design.
features: KVM backend on Linux; HVF backend on macOS
x86_64 Linux; aarch64 Linux and macOS
AMD SEV/SNP and Intel TDX confidential-computing hooks
name: Alioth

description: Embeddable microVM VMM library for running untrusted code in milliseconds with no guest OS; CNCF Sandbox project.
features: typed host↔guest function calls; default-deny host access model
Hyperlight-Unikraft variant runs ordinary Linux programs + snapshot support
used by Microsoft Agent Framework CodeAct
name: Hyperlight

description: EC2 feature for carving cryptographically isolated, hardened VMs ('enclaves') out of an instance; underlying Nitro VMM is proprietary, CLI/driver/tooling are open source.
features: isolated VMs with no persistent storage, interactive access, or default networking
Nitro Secure Module (NSM) with cryptographic attestation
EIF image format built from Docker images + signed blobs
parent↔enclave communication over vsock; vsock-proxy for egress
name: AWS Nitro Enclaves tooling

description: Shared Rust virtualization component ecosystem (KVM bindings, virtio, vhost, device models); building blocks, NOT a runnable VMM.
features: used by Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, crosvm, StratoVirt, Dragonball
name: rust-vmm

description: COMMERCIAL / PARTIALLY OPEN - hardened container runtime using Xen/PVH-based type-1 isolation ('zones'); core daemon is proprietary, selected components are open source. NOT an open-source VMM.
features: each container in its own Xen PVH 'zone' with minimal guest kernel
open components: protobuf APIs, 'Am I Isolated' tooling, Falco plugin, learning materials
Rust Xen services, Styrolite, GPU PCIe passthrough in 2025 Trail of Bits audit scope
name: Edera Protect

description: Containerd integration that runs containers as Firecracker microVMs.
name: firecracker-containerd

description: MicroVM lifecycle management service (formerly Weaveworks), now community-run; upstream-recommended successor to Weave Ignite.
name: Flintlock

description: 2026 warm-pool manager for Flintlock microVMs to cut cold-start latency.
name: battery

description: Simple CLI for launching raw Firecracker microVMs without containerd.
features: thin wrapper over the Firecracker API
name: firectl

description: NixOS-based declarative orchestration for microVM fleets.
features: backends: QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor, Firecracker, crosvm, kvmtool, StratoVirt, Alioth, vfkit
share host nix store via virtio-fs/9p
name: microvm.nix

description: Apple's 2025 open-source Swift framework for running Linux containers in lightweight VMs on macOS.
features: purpose-built lightweight Linux VM per container on Apple Silicon
name: Apple Containerization

description: Ran OCI images as Firecracker microVMs. ARCHIVED 2023-12-07; upstream recommends Flintlock.
name: Weave Ignite

description: rust-vmm reference VMM. ARCHIVED / maintenance ended; maintainers pointed users to Cloud Hypervisor.
features: reference VMM built on rust-vmm crates
name: vmm-reference

description: QEMU-derived cloud VMM. ARCHIVED / inactive; Cloud Hypervisor is its successor.
name: Intel NEMU

description: Serverless compute and containers on Firecracker microVMs.
name: AWS Lambda / Fargate

description: Every Fly.io workload runs as a Firecracker microVM; suspend/resume via Firecracker snapshots.
name: Fly.io Machines

description: Runs untrusted or AI-generated code inside ephemeral Firecracker microVMs; GA Jan 30, 2026.
name: Vercel Sandbox

description: AI agent cloud sandboxes on Firecracker-based infrastructure.
features: Firecracker-based infra (community sources; no E2B primary doc re-verified)
name: E2B

description: Serverless cloud for AI workloads; sandboxes use gVisor (runsc) - not a microVM platform.
name: Modal

description: Full-stack AI infra with selectable isolation: Kata Containers + Cloud Hypervisor primary, Firecracker and gVisor options.
features: team contributes upstream to Kata/QEMU/Cloud Hypervisor
name: Northflank

description: ChromeOS Linux (Crostini) and Android (ARCVM) guests run on crosvm.
features: Linux and Android guests on ChromeOS
name: ChromeOS (Crostini / ARCVM)

description: Android's Terminal app and Cuttlefish virtual devices run on crosvm.
name: Android (Terminal app / Cuttlefish)

description: Serverless containers and Kubernetes nodes sandboxed with gVisor.
features: gVisor sandboxing (cited in Modal security materials and gVisor ADOPTERS.md)
name: Google Cloud Run / GKE

description: EC2 enclave feature users: proprietary Nitro VMM with open-source CLI/driver tooling.
name: Nitro Enclaves users
